merchant/30516.htm.text: Weapon Merchant Reep: Welcome, customer! I am Reep, the manager of this branch of the Golden Wheel guild. Remember, the price of armor and weapons doesn't always reflect their quality. Am I saying that it doesn't matter? Of course not! But you should judge them independently of the cost. For someon…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30516-1.htm.text: Weapon Merchant Reep: What can I do for you, customer? I'll tell you again that the most important thing is an appreciative eye.

merchant/30516-pk.htm.text: Weapon Merchant Reep: Our policy is not to sell items to people who do not recognize their value. I do feel bad ... I personally would prefer to show you many items, but, oh well, that is the discipline of business, right? I am very sorry.

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30516-01..text: Trader Reep: Star Diamond? I went on a business trip to Giran expressly for Gouph, and acquired the Star Diamond, that is a fact. I was going to bring it here myself... But Gouph insisted that one of his guild members, Carrier Torocco , be in charge of delivery... So, I gave the jewel to Torocco as…

Q00108_JumbleTumbleDiamondFuss/30516-02..text: Trader Reep: Why have you come back? Didn't I tell you? I don't have the Star Diamond! The last person who had the jewel was Carrier Torocco . If you find him, show him the Contract I gave you and ask him why the delivery is taking so long. I have nothing to do with this anymore, so don't come back…
